items.answer: Our service includes inspection of common hiding areas, targeted treatment and guidance on preparation, follow-up and prevention based on your infestation.
items.question: What does your professional bed bug treatment service include?

items.answer: One-time service is designed for customers seeking treatment for a current bed bug infestation, with the treatment approach based on property and infestation conditions.
items.question: What is a one-time bed bug treatment?

items.answer: The One-Year Plan includes three scheduled service visits during the year, providing continued treatment support and follow-up based on service requirements.
items.question: What is included in the One-Year Bed Bug Service Plan?

items.answer: Our One-Year Bed Bug Plan includes three scheduled visits. Visit timing and service requirements are discussed based on the property and infestation condition.
items.question: How many visits are included in the One-Year Bed Bug Plan?

items.answer: The right option depends on infestation level, property conditions and service requirements. Our team can help you choose between one-time and three-visit plans.
items.question: Should I choose one-time service or the One-Year Plan?

items.answer: Yes, suitable areas such as mattresses, bed frames, headboards, sofas and furniture can be inspected and treated as part of the selected service.
items.question: Does bed bug treatment cover mattresses and furniture?

items.answer: No. Our bed bug service does not use smoke or steam. We use targeted treatment methods selected according to the property and infestation.
items.question: Do you use smoke or steam for bed bug treatment?

items.answer: Preparation may include reducing clutter, washing bedding and providing access to beds, furniture and other areas requiring treatment. Instructions are provided before service.
items.question: Do I need to prepare my home before bed bug treatment?

items.answer: Follow-up depends on the service selected. The One-Year Plan includes three scheduled visits, while one-time service is provided according to its agreed service terms.
items.question: Is follow-up included with bed bug treatment?

items.answer: Contact our team to discuss your bed bug problem, arrange an inspection and choose between one-time service or the One-Year Plan with three scheduled visits.
items.question: How do I book your bed bug treatment service?
